title: Awash Heavy Rail Transit Overpass
subtitle: Fabrication and precision erection of 14,200 metric tons of continuous curved box girders
challenge: The Awash Freight rail link required 14,200 metric tons of heavy structural steel girders to cross active railway intersections without disrupting existing bulk cargo traffic. The geometry required complex curved box sections with strict ultrasonic weld integrity tolerances under dynamic 30-ton axle loads.
solution: Division 01 engineered 48-meter modular box sections in-plant using automated tandem submerged arc welding gantries. Complete trial assembly and 3D laser geometric scans were conducted in our Addis Ababa fabrication yard prior to heavy convoy transport.
engineeringExecution: By manufacturing 48m monolithic spans with pre-installed splice plates and applying a 3-layer zinc/epoxy/polyurethane protective system in a controlled climate booth, site assembly crane time was reduced by 60%, minimizing rail corridor shutdowns to 48-hour weekend windows.

results.context: 100% full penetration welds verified via radiographic inspection

results.context: Delivered in 14 months against an 18-month contractual milestone

results.context: Zero structural defects recorded across 3,200 tested weld seams

results.context: Engineered for 32.5-ton axle dynamic freight traffic

title: Dire Dawa International Trade Terminal
subtitle: Complete turnkey structural steel framing, long-span trusses, and automated crane runways
location: Dire Dawa Free Trade Zone, Ethiopia
challenge: Construction of a 42,000 m² covered logistics warehouse requiring 36m clear-span overhead crane runways capable of supporting dual 50-ton gantry cranes operating in continuous shifts.
solution: Division 01 and Division 04 collaborated to engineer heavy welded plate girders and motorized overhead crane rail assemblies with strict deflection limits under dynamic heavy braking forces.
engineeringExecution: Utilized high-strength S355JR structural steel and automated CNC drilling for friction-grip bolted splices, enabling rapid crane gantry alignment within 1.5mm tolerances over 300m rail lengths.

results.label: Structural Steel Fabricated
results.context: Covering 42,000 m² clear-span industrial floor space

results.label: Crane Runway Rating
results.context: Continuous dynamic fatigue rated crane runway beams

results.label: On-Budget Delivery
results.context: Zero contractual cost variations across project scope

title: Modjo Dry Port Heavy Precast Pavements
subtitle: Engineered precast concrete slabs designed for 100-ton container reach-stacker wheel loads
challenge: Heavy container handling at the inland dry port caused rapid asphalt rutting and ground subsidence under 100-ton loaded reach stackers.
solution: Division 02 engineered modular high-strength precast concrete slabs (C60/75) with interlocking steel tongue-and-groove joints that distribute extreme point loads across prepared sub-bases.
engineeringExecution: Casting 35,000 m² of precast panels under controlled factory steam-curing conditions ensured maximum compressive strength and zero surface micro-cracking.

results.label: Heavy Pavement Installed
results.context: Installed without halting ongoing daily port operations

results.label: Point Load Rating
results.context: Rated for super-heavy reach stacker axle loads

results.label: Maintenance-Free Life
results.context: Eliminates recurrent annual asphalt resurfacing costs

title: Somali Regional Water Transmission Main
subtitle: Manufacturing of 142 kilometers of PE100 HDPE municipal pressure pipelines
challenge: Providing reliable bulk potable water transmission through desert terrain with high ground salinity, daytime thermal expansion, and rugged transport routes.
solution: Division 03 manufactured 142 km of UV-stabilized PE100 high-density polyethylene pressure pipe (PN16 and PN20, diameters 250mm – 630mm) with co-extruded white outer reflective layers.
engineeringExecution: Continuous extrusion at Plant 1 with ultrasonic wall thickness monitoring, followed by automated buttweld training and electrofusion fitting certification for local field contractors.

results.label: Pressure Endurance
results.context: Zero burst or leakage events during hydrostatic pressure testing

results.label: Citizens Benefited
results.context: Securing clean potable water supply to arid regional communities
